name: Azure DevOps PR Lifecycle
description: Operate an authorized Azure Repos pull request through local preparation, policies, independent review, and guarded completion decisions.
approval_boundaries: Require explicit authority for PR creation, voting, auto-complete, completion, and work-item mutation.

phases.name: PR context
phases.instructions: Identify repository rules, branch state, requested PR action, and authorization.

phases.name: Source check
phases.instructions: Confirm local change scope and acceptance criteria.

phases.name: Conditional local change
phases.instructions: Apply only authorized local changes, or record that none are needed.

phases.name: Authorized PR operation
phases.instructions: Perform only the currently authorized PR action.

phases.name: Work item traceability
phases.instructions: When authorized, link or update work items; otherwise record no-action.

phases.name: Required policies
phases.instructions: Inspect required policies and build validation.

phases.name: Independent PR review
phases.instructions: Review metadata, work-item linkage, reviewers, policies, comments, and CI.

phases.name: Completion readiness
phases.instructions: Before completion or auto-complete, confirm validation, rollback, and required gates.

phases.name: PR lifecycle handoff
phases.instructions: Report PR state, actions, policies, approvals, risks, and next action.
